derivation.behavior: Connection and bandwidth limits support global, host and download scopes.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go central limiter arbitrates connection permits and byte rate fairly using monotonic time.

invariants: Global, host, and download connection caps are enforced by one arbiter.
A blocked host does not consume capacity available to another host.
Global and queue/profile/download byte-rate scopes compose through monotonic reservations.
Equal active transfers receive fair reservation opportunities and independently accounted bytes.
Live limit changes wake eligible connection waiters and affect subsequent byte reservations.
Cancellation removes queued connection requests and released leases return capacity.
Diagnostics expose active/peak connections, wait/cancellation counters, bytes and limit revision.
